title: Base-resolution models of transcription-factor binding reveal soft motif syntax
summary: BPNet predicted base-resolution binding profiles of pluripotency transcription factors from DNA sequence; interpretation revealed soft motif syntax rules such as helical periodicity of Nanog binding and directional cooperativity, validated with CRISPR-induced point mutations.
ai_technology: BPNet, a deep learning model of base-resolution ChIP-nexus profiles

source_review.scope: Europe PMC metadata and abstract only; Methods not read.

evidence.tested: CRISPR point-mutation validation reported in abstract.
evidence.unknown: Generality beyond studied TFs/cell type not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: Model interpretation yielded the motif syntax rules.
